title: GMKtec NucBox G5S Mini PC Intel N5095 (4C/4T up to 2.9GHz) 8GB+128GB Pink
writeup: The GMKtec NucBox G5S is a Windows 11 Pro-ready mini PC for email, web, video calls and a simple two-screen desk. GMKtec lists an Intel Celeron N5095 (4 cores, 4 threads), 8GB LPDDR4, a 128GB M.2 SATA SSD, two HDMI 2.0 ports at 4K 60Hz, Wi-Fi 6 and three USB-A ports, in a 72 x 72 x 44.5mm body that weighs about 206g. It is $189.99 new. The drawbacks: the 8GB RAM is soldered, and its only USB-C port accepts power input only.
